### Setup

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(lavaan)
library(plotgardener)
```

### CFA

```{r}

cfa_model = '# Latent variables
            AD_pathology      =~ ptau217_ab42_residual + ab_suvr + ab_pos_new + ptau181_residual
            Neurodegeneration =~ nfl_residual + meta_roi_inv + hippcampul_residual_inv
            Cognition         =~ zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv + zscore_interm_sevlt_inv + zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv + zscore_delay_svelt_inv + zscore_wms_digit_inv + zscore_trail_ab_inv + zscore_fas_inv + zscore_animal_naming_inv

            # Covariances 
            meta_roi_inv          ~~ hippcampul_residual_inv
            zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv  ~~ zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv
            zscore_interm_sevlt_inv   ~~ zscore_delay_svelt_inv
            zscore_fas_inv  ~~  zscore_animal_naming_inv
            ab_suvr   ~~ ab_pos_new'
cfa_fit = cfa(cfa_model, data = sem_data_sdoh, missing = 'fiml')
summary(cfa_fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
modificationindices(cfa_fit) %>% arrange(desc(mi))

```

### SEM

```{r}


sem_model = '# Latent variables
            AD_pathology      =~ ptau181_residual + ptau217_ab42_residual + ab_suvr + ab_pos_new
            Neurodegeneration =~ nfl_residual + meta_roi_inv + hippcampul_residual_inv
            Cognition         =~ zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv + zscore_interm_sevlt_inv + zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv + zscore_delay_svelt_inv + zscore_wms_digit_inv + zscore_trail_ab_inv + zscore_fas_inv + zscore_animal_naming_inv

            # Covariances 
            meta_roi_inv          ~~ hippcampul_residual_inv
            zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv  ~~ zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv
            zscore_interm_sevlt_inv   ~~ zscore_delay_svelt_inv
            zscore_fas_inv  ~~  zscore_animal_naming_inv
            
            ab_suvr       ~~ ab_pos_new
            
            AD_pathology ~~ Neurodegeneration 
            Neurodegeneration ~~ Cognition
            
            # Regression
            AD_pathology       ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + sex + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4
            Neurodegeneration  ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + sex + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4
            Cognition          ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + sex + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4'
sem_fit = sem(sem_model, data = sem_data_sdoh, missing = 'fiml', fixed.x = TRUE)
summary(sem_fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
modificationindices(sem_fit) %>% arrange(desc(mi))
residuals(sem_fit, type = "standardized")


sem_sex_model = '# Latent variables
            AD_pathology      =~ ptau181_residual + ptau217_ab42_residual + ab_suvr + ab_pos_new
            Neurodegeneration =~ nfl_residual + meta_roi_inv + hippcampul_residual_inv
            Cognition         =~ zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv + zscore_interm_sevlt_inv + zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv + zscore_delay_svelt_inv + zscore_wms_digit_inv + zscore_trail_ab_inv + zscore_fas_inv + zscore_animal_naming_inv

            # Covariances 
            meta_roi_inv          ~~ hippcampul_residual_inv
            zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv  ~~ zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv
            zscore_interm_sevlt_inv   ~~ zscore_delay_svelt_inv
            zscore_fas_inv  ~~  zscore_animal_naming_inv
            
            ab_suvr       ~~ ab_pos_new
            
            AD_pathology ~~ Neurodegeneration 
            Neurodegeneration ~~ Cognition
            
            # Regression
            AD_pathology       ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4
            Neurodegeneration  ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4
            Cognition          ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4'
sem_sex_fit = sem(sem_sex_model, data = sem_data_sdoh, missing = 'fiml', group = "sex", fixed.x = TRUE)
summary(sem_sex_fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)


sem_race_model = '# Latent variables
            AD_pathology      =~ ptau181_residual + ptau217_ab42_residual + ab_suvr + ab_pos_new
            Neurodegeneration =~ nfl_residual + meta_roi_inv + hippcampul_residual_inv
            Cognition         =~ zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv + zscore_interm_sevlt_inv + zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv + zscore_delay_svelt_inv + zscore_wms_digit_inv + zscore_trail_ab_inv + zscore_fas_inv + zscore_animal_naming_inv

            # Covariances 
            meta_roi_inv          ~~ hippcampul_residual_inv
            zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv  ~~ zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv
            zscore_interm_sevlt_inv   ~~ zscore_delay_svelt_inv
            zscore_fas_inv  ~~  zscore_animal_naming_inv
            
            ab_suvr       ~~ ab_pos_new
            
            AD_pathology ~~ Neurodegeneration 
            Neurodegeneration ~~ Cognition
            
            # Regression
            AD_pathology       ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + age_z + sex
            Neurodegeneration  ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + age_z + sex
            Cognition          ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + age_z + sex'
sem_race_fit = sem(sem_race_model, data = sem_data_sdoh, missing = 'fiml', group = "race", fixed.x = TRUE)
summary(sem_race_fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

```


### Distribution


```{r}

vars = c("prs_z_prscsx", "cogd_sem", "apoe4", "SDoH",
          "lang_Spanish", "age_z", "sex", "PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4")

sem_complete = sem_data_sdoh[complete.cases(sem_data_sdoh[, vars]), ]
lat_score = lavPredict(sem_fit) # extract latent scores
sem_df = cbind(sem_complete[c("cdx_cog", "sex", "race")], lat_score, SDoH = sem_complete$SDoH)
sem_df$cdx_cog = factor(sem_df$cdx_cog,
                         levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                         labels = c("Cognitively Normal", "MCI", "Dementia"))



a = ggplot(sem_df, aes(x = AD_pathology, fill = cdx_cog)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Aβ/Tau (Latent Score)",
      y = "Density",
       fill = "Cognitive Diagnosis") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dementia" = "#d62728",   
                               "MCI" = "#2ca02c",      
                               "Cognitively Normal" = "#1f77b4")) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlim(min(sem_df$AD_pathology, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
       max(sem_df$AD_pathology, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5)


b = ggplot(sem_df, aes(x = Neurodegeneration, fill = cdx_cog)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Neurodegeneration (Latent Score)", 
       y = "Density",
       fill = "Cognitive Diagnosis") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dementia" = "#d62728",   
                               "MCI" = "#2ca02c",      
                               "Cognitively Normal" = "#1f77b4")) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "none") +
  xlim(min(sem_df$Neurodegeneration, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
       max(sem_df$Neurodegeneration, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5)


c = ggplot(sem_df, aes(x = Cognition, fill = cdx_cog)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Cognition (Latent Score)", 
       y = "Density",
       fill = "Cognitive Diagnosis") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dementia" = "#d62728",   
                               "MCI" = "#2ca02c",      
                               "Cognitively Normal" = "#1f77b4")) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "none") + 
  xlim(min(sem_df$Cognition, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
       max(sem_df$Cognition, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5)


d = ggplot(sem_df, aes(x = SDoH, fill = cdx_cog)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "SDoH (Latent Score)", 
       y = "Density",
       fill = "Cognitive Diagnosis") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dementia" = "#d62728",   
                               "MCI" = "#2ca02c",      
                               "Cognitively Normal" = "#1f77b4")) + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "none") +
  xlim(min(sem_df$SDoH, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5,
       max(sem_df$SDoH, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.3)

legend = get_legend(a)
a = a + theme(legend.position = "none")



pageCreate(width = 8, height = 8.5, default.units = "inches") 

plotGG(
  plot = a,
  x = 0, y = 0, width = 4, height = 4,       
  just = c("left", "top"), default.units = "inches"
  )

plotGG(
  plot = b,
  x = 4, y = 0, width = 4, height = 4,       
  just = c("left", "top"), default.units = "inches"
  )

plotGG(
 plot = c,
  x = 0, y = 4, width = 4, height = 4,        
  just = c("left", "top"), default.units = "inches"
  )

plotGG(
 plot = d,
  x = 4, y = 4, width = 4, height = 4,        
  just = c("left", "top"), default.units = "inches"
  )

plotGG(
  plot = legend,
  x = 2, y = 8, width = 4, height = 0.5,
  just = c("left", "top"),
  default.units = "inches"
)

pageGuideHide()

dev.off()


# Do distributions of one group statistically vary from another?)

# distribution between two groups
vars = c("AD_pathology", "Neurodegeneration", "Cognition", "SDoH")

ks_by_group = function(g1, g2) {
  sapply(vars, function(v) {
    ks.test(
      sem_df[[v]][sem_df$cdx_cog == g1],
      sem_df[[v]][sem_df$cdx_cog == g2]
    )$p.value
  })
}

# Dementia vs Cognitively Normal
ks_by_group("Dementia", "Cognitively Normal")
# Cognitively Normal vs MCI
ks_by_group("Cognitively Normal", "MCI")

```

### Demographics

```{r}
sem_sdoh_copy = sem_data_sdoh
sem_sdoh_copy$id_education = data$id_education
vars = c("prs_z_prscsx", "cogd_sem", "apoe4", "SDoH",
          "lang_Spanish", "age_z", "sex", "PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4")
sem_complete = sem_sdoh_copy[complete.cases(sem_sdoh_copy[, vars]), ]


summary_df = sem_complete %>%
  filter(!is.na(cdx_cog)) %>%
  mutate(
    cdx_cog = factor(
      cdx_cog,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2),
      labels = c("Cognitively Normal", "Mild cognitive impairment", "Dementia"))) %>%
  group_by(cdx_cog) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),

    Age = sprintf("%.1f (± %.1f)", mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Female = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(sex == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(sex == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `NHW` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(race == "NHW", na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(race == "NHW", na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Latinx` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(race == "Hispanic", na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(race == "Hispanic", na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Black` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(race == "Black", na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(race == "Black", na.rm = TRUE)),
    Education = sprintf("%.1f (± %.1f)", mean(id_education, na.rm = TRUE), sd(id_education, na.rm = TRUE)),

    `APOEε4 Carrier`    = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(apoe4 == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(apoe4 == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    CogDRisk = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(cogd, na.rm = TRUE), sd(cogd, na.rm = TRUE)),
    PRSCSx = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(prs_z_prscsx, na.rm = TRUE), sd(prs_z_prscsx, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Adverse SDoH Latent Score` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(SDoH, na.rm = TRUE), sd(SDoH, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Healthcare and Economic Adversity Latent Score` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(HEA, na.rm = TRUE), sd(HEA, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Anxiety Latent Score` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(AX, na.rm = TRUE), sd(AX, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Social Adversity Latent Score` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(SA, na.rm = TRUE), sd(SA, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    `SEVLT Immediate` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(zscore_interm_sevlt, na.rm = TRUE), sd(zscore_interm_sevlt, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `SEVLT Delayed` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(zscore_delay_svelt, na.rm = TRUE), sd(zscore_delay_svelt, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `WMS-III Logical Memory I` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(zscore_interm_wms_mem, na.rm = TRUE), sd(zscore_interm_wms_mem, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `WMS-III Logical Memory II` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(zscore_delay_wms_mem, na.rm = TRUE), sd(zscore_delay_wms_mem, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `WMS-III Digit Span` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(zscore_wms_digit, na.rm = TRUE), sd(zscore_wms_digit, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Trail Making Test A&B` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(zscore_trail_ab, na.rm = TRUE), sd(zscore_trail_ab, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `FAS` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(zscore_fas, na.rm = TRUE), sd(zscore_fas, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Animal Making` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(zscore_animal_naming, na.rm = TRUE), sd(zscore_animal_naming, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    `Cortical \nThickness` = sprintf("%.2f (± %.2f)", mean(meta_roi, na.rm = TRUE), sd(meta_roi, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Hippo. \nVolume` = sprintf("%.2f (± %.2f)", mean(z_hippcampul_vol, na.rm = TRUE), sd(z_hippcampul_vol, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    `Amyloid PET Positivity` = sprintf("%.2f (± %.2f)", mean(ab_pos_new, na.rm = TRUE), sd(ab_pos_new, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Amyloid PET Global SUVR` = sprintf("%.2f (± %.2f)", mean(ab_suvr, na.rm = TRUE), sd(ab_suvr, na.rm = TRUE)),

    `pTau181` = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(ptau181, na.rm = TRUE), sd(ptau181, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `pTau217/Aβ42` = sprintf("%.2f (± %.2f)", mean(ptau217_ab42, na.rm = TRUE), sd(ptau217_ab42, na.rm = TRUE)),
    NfL  = sprintf("%.3f (± %.2f)", mean(nfl, na.rm = TRUE), sd(nfl, na.rm = TRUE))
    
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cdx_cog") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable")

table_data = sem_data_sdoh
table_data$id_education = data$id_education

# total cohort

total_summary = table_data %>%
```

```{r}
# Extract model fit for one lavaan object
fit_row = function(fit, model_name) {
  fm = fitMeasures(fit, c("chisq", "df", "tli", "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
  tibble(
    Model = model_name,
    X2    = unname(fm["chisq"]),
    df    = unname(fm["df"]),
    TLI   = unname(fm["tli"]),
    CFI   = unname(fm["cfi"]),
    RMSEA = unname(fm["rmsea"]),
    SRMR  = unname(fm["srmr"])
  )
}

# Add LRT stats to the second row of a two-model comparison
add_lrt = function(tbl, fit_free, fit_equal) {
  lrt = lavTestLRT(fit_free, fit_equal)

  tbl %>%
    mutate(
      Delta_X2 = c(NA, unname(lrt[2, "Chisq diff"])),
      Delta_df = c(NA, unname(lrt[2, "Df diff"])),
      p_LRT    = c(NA, unname(lrt[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]))
    )
}

# Pretty rounding
pretty_tbl = function(x) {
  x %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
}


sex_tbl = bind_rows(
  fit_row(fit_sex_free,  "Free structural paths"),
  fit_row(fit_sex_equal, "Equal structural paths")
) %>%
  add_lrt(fit_sex_free, fit_sex_equal) %>%
  pretty_tbl()


race_tbl = bind_rows(
  fit_row(fit_race_free,  "Free structural paths"),
  fit_row(fit_race_equal, "Equal structural paths")
) %>%
  add_lrt(fit_race_free, fit_race_equal) %>%
  pretty_tbl()

      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_prs)[2, "Chisq diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe)[2, "Chisq diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_cog)[2, "Chisq diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_sdoh)[2, "Chisq diff"])
    ),

      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe)[2, "Df diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_cog)[2, "Df diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_sdoh)[2, "Df diff"])
    ),
    p_LRT = c(
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_prs)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_cog)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_sdoh)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"])
    )
  ) %>%
```
